script.text: As the Arc League Championship continued, Declan confronted a girl with a striking resemblance to Zuzu.
So you're Celina… Not Zuzu Boyle.
Zuzu…who?
Never mind. She's just someone you look a great deal like.
So what then?
We've met before. I am Declan Akaba – Leo Akaba's son. We encountered each other in the Fusion Dimension.
You were the duelist that my father saw the most promise in. Did he send you here as an advance scout for the impending invasion?
Nobody sent me here! I go where I want, when I want. I answer to no one!
I've devoted my life to one single cause: Stopping my father's plan to invade other dimensions and create one supreme world.
I'm assembling duelists who can help me defend our dimension from Leo Akaba. I want you to join me, Celina.
Save it. I'm only here to hunt down and capture those who escaped from the Xyz Dimension.
Leo Akaba may not have sent you here, but know this: If you are not my friend, you are my enemy.
With the first round of the Junior Arc League Championship completed, the tournament continued as a battle royal.
In the next round, duelists will be dueling throughout the whole city!
Well done, Declan. Now the public won't know the difference between tournament duels and battles against Leo's forces.
Right. Which means there won't be a panic. Although our enemy may panic once they realize what we have in store for them…
Another Junior Arc League Championship duelist, Dennis McField, challenged Zuzu to a duel.
Hey there! I forgot to introduce myself. My name's Dennis McField. I think we should duel so we can become better friends, don't y' think Zuzu?
How do you know who I am?
My passionate dream is to become a great dueltainer someday. I'm familiar with the You Show School and its most enchanting entertainer!
You won't get that chance! Because this next duel will be your last!
I didn't know you had a twin!
She does look just like me! You must be Lulu. I'm Zuzu.
I don't care who you are. I have business with this Xyz fugitive.
Xyz fugitive? Um, heh, what is that?
Don't play dumb! I'm taking you down! Arm yourself!
This girl is clearly all mixed up about me. However, a dueltainer always accepts a challenge to keep the crowd entertained!
